jobs.title: Project Manager III (Remote) - (NASA eMITS)
jobs.description:
**Project Manager III (Remote) - (NASA eMITS)**

Rothe is seeking a Project Manager to provide remote project management for the Information Management Division (IMD) in the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) in support of the NASA Enterprise Multimedia and Integrated Technical Services (eMITS) contract. eMITS is the Agency’s enterprise-level contract creating and delivering multimedia and technical communications through the use of the internet, digital platforms, and IT management for NASA’s Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) and Office of Communications (OCOMM). From photographing rocket launches and recoveries, to producing engaging videos, to information technology management, to using social media to share NASA’s message, eMITS integrates services for NASA IT and provides NASA’s communication to the outside world. Come join us in support of NASA’s mission to inspire the world through information and discovery.

**Job Description:**

The Project Manager position will include but not be limited to the following efforts:

Provide IT Service Management (ITSM) project management support focused on the transition/migration from legacy tools to enterprise solutions and the decommissioning of legacy tools once enterprise solutions are operational. Services include project management, lifecycle governance, process re-engineering, data migration oversight, system integration coordination, organizational change management, stakeholder engagement, and training coordination, and vendor and financial governance to include, but is not limited to;

**Functional Responsibilities:**

* Provide the following services in support of Migration and Decommissioning Project Management & Lifecycle Governance
  + Lead the end-to-end lifecycle for the migration and decommissioning of legacy platforms/tools to the new enterprise platform (e.g., ServiceNow).
  + Develop, maintain, and actively track migration and decommissioning schedules, timelines, and milestones to ensure on-time delivery.
* Provide the following services in support of Process Redesign & Workflow Alignment.
  + Map existing workflows (e.g. including Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration Management) to the capabilities of the new platform.
  + Facilitate the optimization and re-engineering of core processes to ensure alignment with platform best practices and organizational requirements.
* Provide the following services in support of Data Migration, Records Retention and Integrations.
  + Oversee the transfer of historical data, Configuration Items (CIs), knowledge articles, user directories, etc. to the new enterprise solutions(s).
  + Oversee required API integration efforts.
* Provide the following services in support of Stakeholder, Change & Quality Management.
  + Coordinate cross-functional teams and champion ongoing buy-in throughout the project lifecycle.
  + Coordinate/Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate system functionality against business requirements prior to launch.
  + Manage organizational change communication, drive user adoption strategies, and coordinate the delivery of training programs for internal support teams.
  + Develop and execute a decommissioning communication plan, providing clear, advanced notification of the final cutoff date and operational impacts to all stakeholders, end-users, and internal support teams.
* Provide Discovery and Dependency Mapping to compile a comprehensive audit to inventory and map all dependencies tied to the legacy tools, including internal and external integrations.
* Manage the clearance of all active queues, ensuring that all open tickets, change requests, and active service catalog items are appropriately resolved, closed, or migrated to the new platform prior to system shutdown.

**Education and Experience:**

Minimum Education: BA/BS in Project Management, Communications, Business Administration, or an IT related discipline

Minimum Experience: 8 years

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8 years of project management experience
* 3-5 years of business/mission (outcomes/impacts), strategic/tactical (project planning) and operational (implementation/service/product delivery)
* Project Management Certification:
  + Project Management Professional (PMP) certification and/or
  + Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) and/or
  + Certified Scrum Master (CSM) and/or
  + Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)
* Experience with Risk Management and best practices
* Experience using tools for requirements gathering and implementation
* Experience in creating and maintaining Integrated master schedules and applying earned value management techniques (desired, not required)
* Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneNote, OneDrive), and SharePoint.

**Preferred Qualifications (not required for consideration):**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* ITIL Certification
* Exceptional stakeholder management and the ability to bridge the gap between technical teams and government customers
* Ability to work in complex, ambiguous, and fast-paced environments
* Strategy Management
* Microsoft SharePoint
* Microsoft Project

For this remote position, the employee bears travel costs to the nearest NASA Center for badging and issue of NASA IT equipment, and must have a reliable internet connection and be able to VPN into the NASA network to conduct work.

Rothe is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Rothe participates in E-Verify.

**Job Title:** Program Manager

**Workband:** SP

**Location:** Global / Remote

**Team:** The Program Manager is a member of the Programs team. In the present accountability structures, they are line-managed by the Vice President of Programs while building and working in more collaborative ways across Programs and the wider organisation.

**About Global Greengrants Fund**

Global Greengrants Fund (GGF) is a public charity registered in Boulder, Colorado, and London, UK, that supports grassroots activists and civil society organizations around the world working to address environmental and social justice in over 160 countries. GGF applies a participatory and decentralized model in making grants to grassroots groups through regional and thematic boards of advisors, global partner networks, and partner funds, to support grassroots environmental and social justice action. Global Greengrants Fund believes solutions to environmental harm and social injustice come from people whose lives are most impacted. Every day, our global network of people on the frontlines and donors comes together to support communities to protect their ways of life and our planet. Because when local people have a say in the health of their food, water, and resources, they are forces for change.

In 2026, Global Greengrants Fund is on a strategic journey in which we collectively center our values, including diversity, equity and inclusion, and organizational care in our work, and to rediscover our identity and potential after 30 years of work. We have experienced growth over the past several years for our annual grantmaking, our philanthropic advocacy, and our global partnerships and collaborations. This includes creating a globally networked learning organization and transforming our organizational culture to be more collaborative and self-steering – we call this our transformative journey. The Program Manager needs to understand the challenges and opportunities that come with these transformations and be able to remain flexible, steady, and adaptable.

**Program strategy and impact areas**  
Across GGF’s three Impact Areas: Energy, Earth, Equity, we hold central that community-led innovations centering local leadership for just energy, land and food sovereignty and for protecting and restoring the earth are essential to achieve a feminist just transition from extractive to regenerative and equitable systems. Equity and justice underpin all GGF grantmaking, program activity and field building.

GGF employs a decentralised decision-making approach to our work, which is focused under our three impact areas. Our approach is led by a global network of regional and thematic Advisory Boards, Independent Funds and Global Recommending partners comprising individual activists and expert advisers located in the countries we serve. Each Advisory Board sets its own strategy for grantmaking and manages its grantmaking budget.

**Program Manager**

The Program Manager has a deep understanding of climate justice and a grounded political analysis of global systems and the role of movements in transforming them, and a deep understanding of philanthropy, grantmaking, and movement accompaniment. They have a commitment to climate, environmental, and social justice and feminist grassroots movements and an understanding of their importance in shifting social, political, and economic systems from ones that are vulnerable, unsustainable, and unjust, to ones that are resilient, sustainable, and equitable.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Facilitate the work of the Advisory Networks, and support implementation of the Program Team and wider organisation’s systems to ensure they are enabling the team and organization to deliver on its work and meet its accountabilities while staying true to its principles and values.
* Lead in the development of systems and procedures to operationalize the team and organizational work plans in alignment with the overall organizational strategic vision and priorities and the needs of the regional and global network.
* Lead in the development of systems to develop, track, and operationalize the program team's annual budgets in alignment with the overall organizational strategic vision and priorities and the needs of the regional and global network.
* Manage all aspects of the program function workflows to ensure that GGF’s programmatic work substantively and effectively advances strategic goals, is highly relevant and responsive to the context of environmental and social justice movements - with a focus on the impact areas, and is aligned with organizational priorities and values.
* Contribute to the analysis and sensemaking of regional and global political context and philanthropic trends, surfacing implications for resourcing and accompanying movements and informing strategy implementation.
* Facilitate the operationalization of work under GGF’s Impact Areas to ensure achievement of organizational outcomes.
* Contribute to program strategy evolution, implementation, monitoring, evaluation and learning for GGF’s program work.
* Contribute to relevant research, design, implementation, and dissemination (including in partnerships with relevant research organizations) to advance programmatic strategic objectives.
* Contribute in designing and deploying various organizational learning and development programs, tools, and change processes that facilitate improved organizational performance and strengthen GGF’s practices as an intersectional grantmaking organization.
* Contribute to an organizational culture of high accountability and continuous improvement that values learning.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, End-to-End Program Management
jobs.description:
**Title:** Sr. Program Manager End-to-End Program Management

**Location:** Remote-US (Kansas City Metro, Princeton, or DC preferred)

**Salary:** up to $198K / annually

**About PSI**

Join Us at PSI - Where You Belong, Grow, and Thrive!

At PSI, we believe that people achieve their best when they feel they truly belong. That’s why fairness and opportunity are at the heart of everything we do - not just words, but values deeply embedded in our culture and the full employee experience.

We’re proud to foster an environment where everyone is supported to reach their full potential. From your first day through every step of your journey with us, you’ll feel the difference in how we work, grow, and succeed together.

What You Can Expect From Us - We know that great work starts with feeling valued. That’s why we’ve benchmarked all our roles against local market rates and why you’ll always see salary details in our job postings. We believe in transparency, and we want you to feel confident that your next move aligns with your expectations.

**About the Role**

The Senior Manager, End-to-End Program Management is a senior leadership position accountable for the strategic leadership, program execution, and client stewardship of one of the organization's largest and most complex portfolios. The role owns program end-to-end delivery - from strategy and contractual commitment through operational execution and measurable client outcomes - across a diverse set of products, services, and delivery partners.

The defining demand of this role is complex program management exercised through cross-functional collaboration. The leader has no single line of authority over every function required to deliver; success depends on orchestrating product management, program management, operations, technology, assessment, finance, and client requirements toward a single integrated plan. The role serves as the primary commercial representative to executive stakeholders and to the client, ensuring “one voice” in all client communication while holding internal partners to shared commitments, milestones, and quality standards.

The position carries a deliberately matrixed reporting relationship - a solid line to Enterprise Enablement and a liaison relationship with PMO, assessment, operations and technology resources. The incumbent must make that structure work through influence, transparency, and disciplined escalation rather than positional authority.

**Role Responsibilities**

***Complex Program Management***

The portfolio spans multiple concurrent workstreams, contractual milestones, and delivery partners. The incumbent is accountable for holding that complexity in a single coherent plan and for the discipline that keeps it current.

* Own the end-to-end program lifecycle for a large-scale, multi-workstream portfolio — strategy, planning, execution, and closeout — consistent enterprise project management standards, and established best practices.
* Manage complex integrated program schedules, including interdependencies among and between subprojects, shared enterprise resources, supplier deliverables, and contractual client milestones.
* Maintain, track, and measure program success metrics across scope, schedule, cost, risk, issues, and change control — with timely, no-surprises reporting to sponsors, program owners, stakeholders, and executive leadership.
* Lead complex initiatives from inception through completion while navigating organizational, financial, technological, and market constraints, including competing priorities and mid-cycle change.
* Establish and attain strategic program goals that require coordinated delivery across multiple departments and business units, sustaining momentum through reorganization, technology change, and resource pressure.
* Provide program-level supervision and direction to assigned project managers, setting standards for planning rigor, risk discipline, and reporting quality across the program team.
* Apply advanced problem-solving and decision-making to ambiguous, high-complexity problems where the approach itself must be designed, not selected.

***Cross-Functional Collaboration & Client Stewardship***

This role succeeds or fails on the strength of its partnerships. The incumbent is expected to operate as the connective tissue between the client, the program team, and every internal function whose work reaches the client.

* Serve as the single commercial point of contact for the client and ensure consistent, one-voice communication to the client across all internal functions and suppliers.
* Partner with operations, technology, assessment, finance, and outsourced suppliers to align capabilities, commitments, and delivery timelines to client requirements.
* Implement and maintain a protocol for assessing client needs and translating them into solutions, with clear hand-offs to the functions accountable for building and delivering them.
* Educate internal stakeholders — including customer-facing teams — on future client capability requirements so roadmap and operational planning reflect real client demand.
* Act as a strategic advocate for the client while ensuring enterprise objectives, contractual commitments, and operational capacity remain aligned; surface and resolve conflicts between the two early.
* Build and sustain executive-level relationships with clients, business partners, suppliers, and industry stakeholders.
* Operate effectively within a matrixed reporting structure, maintaining open and disciplined communication between operations, assessment, technology so that competing client and operational expectations are managed as routine work rather than escalation.

***Operational, Financial & Quality Performance***

* Deliver against all client service-level agreements and contractual obligations; own overall business performance and client satisfaction for the program/s.
* Oversee program budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning; manage to agreed budget

Job Description:

**Team:** Business Operations  
**Salary Range:** $80,000-$115,000 USD  
**Location:** Chicago / Dallas / Atlanta

This role is aligned to our hub locations. While we’re especially interested in candidates in or near these areas, we welcome applications from outside of these locations as well.

**Opportunity for Impact**

Applied is where insurance technology gets reinvented, and we build it fast. Our cloud software and AI-powered solutions reach thousands of agencies and brokers worldwide, setting the pace for what modern insurance can do.

We’re looking for a **Vendor Integration Program Manager** to join our **Business Operations team** and support the operational success of our new, fast-growing Certified Vendor Program and help shape how it scales.

**What You’ll Do**

* Run the onboarding and renewal process for certified vendors, creating a smooth experience for both vendors and customers.
* Coordinate end-to-end integration workflows for third-party vendors, tracking milestones and escalating issues as needed.
* Support vendor billing and fee reconciliation, partnering with Finance and BizOps to keep invoicing and commission payments accurate.
* Build and maintain vendor performance scorecards and recurring reports that show program health and platform impact.
* Act as the day-to-day point of contact for vendors’ business and technical teams, and keep use cases, contract records and program documentation up to date.
* Spot ways to streamline processes across business development, BizOps, CX and Product / Engineering, and partner with stakeholders to put improvements in place.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2–4 years of experience in operations, vendor management, billing or a related function, plus a bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience coordinating multi-step projects with internal and external stakeholders, and proficiency in a project management tool such as Jira, Asana or Smartsheet to track milestones and keep everyone informed.
* A highly organized approach to following and improving workflows, maintaining detailed documentation and managing a growing vendor portfolio, with comfort working with contracts and technical documentation.
* Strong Excel skills and working knowledge of reporting tools to build dashboards, scorecards and billing reports, plus the analytical sense to spot trends or discrepancies and turn them into clear recommendations.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including preparing reporting materials and presentations for program leadership.

Bonus points if you also have:

* Experience at a high-growth SaaS company.
* A track record of documenting existing processes, finding inefficiencies and helping put standardized practices in place for vendor lifecycle management.
* Comfort in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and processes are still being defined.

Talent shows up in a lot of different ways, and we mean that. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experience levels, including military members and their spouses and those without a traditional degree or tech background. If this role speaks to you, apply.

**Why You’ll Like Working on Team Applied**  
The best work happens when smart people move fast, together. For over 40+ years, Applied has built technology that solves real problems for insurance professionals - and we’re still pushing what’s possible.

You’ll be part of our people-first culture built on trust, inclusion, and growth - where you’re supported to deliver, collaborate with teammates who care, and grow with leaders invested in your success.

**How We’ll Support You**

We invest in the whole person, not just the role. Our benefits and resources are built to support your health, your time, and your life outside of work:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
* Holiday and Vacation Time
* Health & Wellness Days
* A Bonus Day for Your Birthday

**Compensation Transparency**

Our targeted starting base salary in the United States for this position considers a variety of factors, including depth and breadth of experience, skills and role scope. Depending on the role, team members may also be eligible for additional compensation plans (bonus and commission).

**Your Security Matters**  
Our candidates’ personal information and online safety are top of mind. Applied communicates with candidates only via a secure @appliedsystems.com email address or through our official careers portal. Recruiters will never request payments or ask for financial account or sensitive personal information like Social Security numbers.

**Background Checks**

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable pre-employment background checks and verification processes.

**AI Utilization**

We leverage AI tools to streamline parts of our recruitment workflow (such as resume parsing and interview scheduling). However, final decisions are always conducted by real humans.

*Applied Systems is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Diversity and Inclusion is a business imperative and is a part of building our brand and reputation. **Profile**
-----------

  

We offer remote work opportunities (AK, AR, AZ, CO, FL, HI, IA, ID, IL, KS, LA, MD, MN, MO, MT, NE, NV, NM, NC, ND, OK, OR, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA/DC, WA, WI & WY only).

  

Our Department of Defense contract requires US citizenship and a favorably adjudicated DOD background investigation for this position.

  

Veterans, Reservists, Guardsmen and military family members are encouraged to apply!

  

**Job Summary**

The Provider Program Manager is responsible for overseeing the design, implementation, and delivery of processes, programs, and policies in an assigned functional area within the provider services departments. The Provider Program Manager ensures that strategic, enterprise-wide programs are well defined, planned, tracked, and communicated in a consistent manner; is responsible for collaborating with C-Suite executives and other stakeholders; and is responsible for deliverables that meet defined requirements and for utilizing project management best practices. The Provider Program Manager will function as both a subject matter expert (SME) and delivery lead and will be assigned to a specific functional area such as value-based care, provider education or credentialing.

  

**Education & Experience**

**Required:**
  
  
• Bachelor's Degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or other related field, or equivalent experience
  
• U.S. Citizenship
  
• Must be able to receive a favorable Interim and adjudicated final Department of Defense (DoD) background investigation
  
• 7+ years of managing projects and/or programs at an enterprise level with at least 5 years in a healthcare related industry and specifically in value based care or alternative payment models provider credentialing, or provider education
  
• Demonstrated success in designing, implementing, and delivery of value-based care, provider education or provider credentialing programs
  
• Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with ability to lead and motivate diverse teams
  
• Experience managing vendor/partnership relationships

• Master's Degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or other related field
  
• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

The Business Operations Manager will work under the direction of our lead COOs and in partnership with client leadership teams. You’ll be responsible for overseeing the implementation of operational initiatives, streamlining systems, and managing ongoing client projects. No two weeks will look the same—you might be building out a project management system one week and facilitating a strategic planning session the next.

Over the years, our mission has expanded to include helping people with other forms of debt - such as refinancing credit cards, which are at all time highs in the US. And we've been able to refinance $6+ Billion in loans through our network of Splash, powered credit union and bank partners who leverage our marketplace and automated loan processing technology. And we've raised over $135 million from investors like partners of DST Global, Citi Ventures, TruStage Ventures, Northwestern Mutual Future Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners, and more.

But at our core, we're still that little company from Cleveland with a big dream: to make people more powerful than their debt and we're just getting started..

### **ABOUT OUR WORKPLACE:**

Splash is remote-first, and proud of it — though our collections team works in-person at our Arizona location.

We spend our days simplifying financial products and getting them into the hands of people who need them most. Right now, we're focused on building financial technologies that fundamentally transform how the industry lends.

Although Splash has been around since 2013, we still operate like a startup — fast-paced, nimble, and full of heart. We're good people who care deeply about doing meaningful work and we approach challenges with creativity, passion, and urgency.

And to hire the best, we provide the best: great health insurance, competitive salaries, and unique benefits like quarterly meet-ups and access to engagement tools that keep us connected — even from afar.

At Splash, everything we do is guided by our values:

**Own It** – We take full accountability and follow through on commitments.

**Raise the Bar** – We move fast, innovate faster, and push through barriers.

**Say the Hard Thing** – We speak up with honesty, respect, and a desire to solve problems and make things better.

**Elevate Each Other** – We win as a team by lifting each other up.

These values show up in how we work and how we connect — whether we're collaborating on big projects or bonding over everyday moments. Yes, we even have Slack channels for #kids-and-pets and #food because we believe being human makes us better teammates.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
-------------------

Splash Financial is seeking an Operations Data Analyst who loves using data to solve problems and drive real business impact. You'll help improve performance across multiple teams by:

* Delivering data-driven insights that inform strategy and decision-making.
* Using AI tools to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
* Building the analysis behind business cases that support growth and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, eager to connect data to real-world outcomes, enjoys collaborating across teams, and is curious about finding better ways of doing things.

### **WHAT YOU'LL DO AT SPLASH:**

* Analyze servicing and collections performance along with application funnels and contact-center metrics.
* Build and maintain automated reports and data files for our lending partners, investors, and vendors, working with your manager to map partner requirements to our data and deliver on time.
* Maintain and extend data models in Snowflake and dbt, and support the dashboards Operations leaders use to run their teams.
* Apply consistent key metrics definitions, help audit existing models, and reconcile our numbers against partner figures.
* Identify performance gaps, test hypotheses with data, and build the analysis behind business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Apply AI tools to streamline analytics work (e.g., AI-assisted dbt development, automated request triage).
* Partner with data engineering, product, and business teams to scope requests and deliver solutions.

### **WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO SPLASH:**

* 3+ years of experience in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role.
* Strong SQL skills and experience building and maintaining data models.
* Proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Sigma, Tableau, or Power BI).
* Strong business acumen and the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to manage your own workload and deliver projects on time with minimal direction.
* Experience working with AI/ML tools or implementing AI-driven solutions.
* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  

**NICE TO HAVE:**

  

* Experience in fintech, financial services, or a high-growth environment.
* Familiarity with Python or another programming language for data analysis.
* Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud.
* Master's degree in a related field.

**WHAT MAKES YOU STANDOUT:**

  

* Business-Minded: Connects data to business impact, not just analysis.
* AI & Analytics Curiosity: Excited to explore LLMs, predictive modeling, and new tools, and quick to put them to work.
* Operationally Grounded: Uses data to improve processes and outcomes.
* Clear Communicator: Turns data into clear, actionable stories for teams and leaders.
* Collaborative: Builds trust and works well across Ops, Product, and other teams.
* Ownership: Proactive self-starter who raises concerns early and follows through.
* Adaptability: Shifts focus quickly as priorities change while keeping existing work on track.
* Member-Centric: Always ties insights back to improving customer experience.

### **COMPENSATION:**

  

The base salary range for this role is $61,000 to $97,000 annually, based on market data and internal compensation practices. Final compensation will be determined by factors such as location, experience, and skill level.

**SPLASHERS ENJOY:**

* Fully remote work freedom *(for most roles)*
* Competitive salary packages

jobs.title: Client Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**  
  
The Senior BI & Data Quality Analyst will serve as the primary steward of data quality, governance, and reporting integrity for the Verizon Value business. This role is responsible for ensuring that data used internally and shared with Verizon stakeholders is accurate, consistent, timely, and trusted across all reporting and analytical deliverables.

* Reduction in reporting rework and manual validation effort.
* Improved data quality and reporting accuracy metrics.
* Increased stakeholder confidence in reported results.

**Operational Efficiency**

* Reduction in manual reporting effort through automation.
* Faster report production and dashboard deployment.

* Increased utilization of analytics for business decision-making.

jobs.title: EDW Senior Healthcare Business/Data Analyst
jobs.description:
For over twenty-seven years RCR Technology Corporation has delivered the highest quality services to our clients with an expansive portfolio of industry-relevant services, and deep technical capabilities around data management and application development.

We are seeking a Senior Business/Data Analyst to support the State Medicaid Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and works closely with the Medicaid SME on federal and State reporting. The role owns core BA work with limited supervision: gathering and managing requirements, documenting business rules and processes, facilitating and documenting meetings, and tracking decisions and action items. The analyst also does hands-on data analysis in SQL to validate requirements, research data questions, and support testing of reports.

This role helps the SME focus on policy and leadership-level work by owning the day-to-day documentation, coordination, and analysis that keep reporting deliverables moving. It also builds backup knowledge on the team for Medicaid and federal reporting processes.

Primary Responsibilities

* Gather, document, and manage business requirements for EDW reports, extracts, and enhancements, including federal reporting such as CMS-64/CMS-21 support, MARS, T-MSIS, and PERM.

* Analyze current business processes and systems and document requirements for new or changed processes.

* Help translate federal and State Medicaid policy and reporting guidance into business rules and requirements, with direction from the Medicaid SME.

* Write clear requirements artifacts: business requirements, business rules, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, data mappings, and process flows.

* Maintain requirements traceability from request through design, testing, and delivery.

* Schedule and facilitate working sessions with State business users, Optum technical teams, and other partners. Capture minutes, decisions, action items, and follow-ups.

* Track open questions, dependencies, and risks for assigned work, and escalate issues to the SME and project lead when needed.

* Write SQL to profile and analyze Medicaid enrollment, eligibility, provider, claims, encounter, and financial data to answer business questions and confirm requirements.

* Identify and document data anomalies and report variances, and work with ETL, BI, and QA teams to resolve them.

* Share use cases with data and quality analysts for profiling, review results, and confirm alignment with project requirements and Medicaid/CMS guidelines.

* Support testing and UAT, including test scenarios, acceptance criteria, defect reporting, and follow-up.

* Prepare presentations, summaries, and status updates for the SME, internal leadership, and the customer.

* Maintain business documentation, data definitions, the Operations Guide, and related process documentation in SharePoint and Azure DevOps.

* Support end-user training and training materials related to reports and data.

* Mentor junior analysts and serve as backup to the Medicaid SME on day-to-day business questions and reporting processes.

* Peer review project artifacts and help manage intake and change requests, including impact analysis and BA effort estimates.

* Other duties consistent with the role, as assigned.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, public health, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* 8+ years of business analysis experience, including requirements gathering, documentation, stakeholder facilitation, and user acceptance testing.

* 5+ years of experience working with healthcare data such as claims, encounters, eligibility/enrollment, provider, or financial data.

* 3+ years of experience with Medicaid or public-sector healthcare programs, such as State Medicaid/CHIP agencies, MMIS/MES vendors, Medicaid data warehouses, or Medicaid managed care plans.

* 3+ years of experience writing SQL to analyze and validate data in a relational database or data warehouse.

* Understanding of Fee for Service and managed care claim adjudication, from eligibility and enrollment through claims processing to funding/finance, including managed care encounters.

* Basic understanding of CMS reporting requirements for Medicaid.

* Experience writing use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria and supporting testing/UAT.

* Experience facilitating meetings and documenting outcomes.

* Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, MS Project, SharePoint, and Teams.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Self-starter who is organized and detail-oriented, and able to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines with limited supervision.

jobs.title: Data Analyst

As a Data Analyst, you will support a key Federal customer with robust and repeatable data manipulation, large scale infrastructure for data ingestion, and interactive data visualization for custom client applications.

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Responsible for data mining, data preparation, and reporting.
* Prepares and conducts analyses and studies, needs/gaps assessments.
* Applies knowledge to determine the accuracy and reasonableness of the data, recommendations, and solutions proposed.
* Documents and summarizes the results and develops and recommended solutions to the customer’s problems.
* Prepares big data, implements data models developed by others, and provides database support for customer solutions.
* Serves as a key member of a data science project team, supporting data scientists or other consultants in the performance of assigned tasks.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Four (4) years relevant experience in applied research, big data analytics, statistics, applied mathematics, data science, computer science, operations research or other closely related other quantitative or mathematical discipline. At least two (2) years of experience applied data science research or big data analytics.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research or other closely related scientific or technical discipline A Master’s degree may be substituted for up to two (2) years of relevant experience. A PhD may be substituted for experience.

* Ability to travel for initial onboarding and laptop pickup (estimated 1 day)

* Experience with analytic techniques such as Anomaly detection, Clustering, and Time-series (e.g., ARIMA), and NLP concepts (including preprocessing, TF-IDF, Named Entity Recognition, and LLMs)
* Expertise with Qlik and/or other BI tools such as Tableau and PowerBI.

**About Metergy Solutions, LLC. (“Metergy”)**

Metergy has the energy, rapid growth and excitement of a startup, together with a rock-solid, recession-proof business that has a 45 year track record. We’re a technology company that drives huge carbon emission reductions. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity.

As one of North America’s most experienced submetering providers, Metergy has brought turnkey solutions to clients for over 45 years. Metergy supplies, installs and remotely reads meters to measure individual suite consumption of electricity, water, gas, and thermal energy in multi-residential and commercial buildings, and bills and collects for the cost of commodities and administrative charges for the services provided. The business model allows for long-term recurring revenue through an innovative Submetering as a Service (SaaS) model. Submetering is proven to reduce in-suite energy consumption by 40%, driving decarbonization efforts for Metergy’s clients. This performance has enabled Metergy to issue green bonds and obtain green financing.

Positioned as the #1 submeter provider in the New York and Canadian markets, and one of the largest in North America, Metergy has more than 900,000 contracted meters, issues over 4M utility bills annually and has over 500 team members. Metergy is a portfolio company of Brookfield Infrastructure Partners. Brookfield is one of the world’s largest investors, owners and operators of infrastructure assets across the utilities, transport, energy, data and sustainable resources sectors. This sponsorship provides Metergy with access to large-scale capital, infrastructure investment expertise and global reach.

Provide building owners and occupants with accurate and reliable utility consumption data through market-leading expertise in turnkey submetering and billing, while fostering a workplace with inspired team members empowered to do more good.

New York City Emergency Management (NYCEM) helps New Yorkers before, during, and after emergencies through preparedness, education, and response. The Office of the Chief Operating Officer (COO) is comprised of Human Capital Management (HCM), Information Technology (IT), Support Services, and Geographic Information Systems (GIS). The Office of the COO is focused on implementing agency initiatives and strategies and incorporating them into daily operations to meet agency objectives and goals.
  
  
The NYCEM Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Unit produces reliable location-based information through the integration, analysis, and visualization of essential data distributed in the form of maps, datasets, summary metrics, and associated applications.
  
NYCEM has an exciting opportunity for a motivated GIS Specialist to join the Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Division at New York City Emergency Management (NYCEM).
  
  
Under the supervision of the Deputy Director, Public Safety GIS Data Development Center, the selected applicant will work as a GIS Specialist to analyze, visualize and report on geospatial information to support the agency’s executive, planning, and operations staff. The GIS Specialist will work as part of the Division’s Public Safety GIS Data Development Center to perform data acquisition, QA/QC, data maintenance, and data management tasks. In addition, the applicant will create map templates, paper maps, and web applications in support of preparedness and response operations. The selected applicant will also work on python-based GIS tools, to support geospatial data science and administrative workflows. The selected applicant will serve as an early-career GIS specialist within a team of GIS professionals.
  
  
In addition, the selected applicant will:
  
Identify and acquire citywide data resources from NYC OpenData, geospatial data services, and partner agencies.
  

* Support GIS staff and agency users with the development and deployment of geospatial data and related tools.
* Perform detailed QA/QC on key datasets and maintain data consistency between NYCEM's on-premises and cloud-based environments.
* Accept ad hoc rapid data acquisition, mapping, geospatial analysis, and reporting requests.

* Create applications, dashboards, and experiences in Esri Enterprise and ArcGIS Online.
* Collect, analyze and display GIS data using applications including but not limited to: ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, Fulcrum, Tableau, Microsoft and Adobe products.
* Support GIS staff and agency users with development and deployment of GIS applications and data collection tools.
* Assist in the management of the GIS knowledge base, including but not limited to overseeing related documents, templates, and workflows.
* Assist in the development of training and exercise programs for GIS and non-GIS staff.

You will also support the documentation and analysis of end-to-end business processes, ensuring they align with organizational goals and compliance standards.

* Business Process Analysis & Documentation: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand end-to-end business processes, translating them into detailed activity flows, data maps, business rules, and decision models. Work with subject matter experts to create and maintain process documentation, including standard operating procedures and workflows.

**Job Summary – Position Eligible for $10,000 Sign-on Bonus – Subject to 12 Month Commitment**  
Newberry Group is seeking an experienced, analytical **Cyber Threat Analyst** to join our customer’s Defensive Cyber Operations (DCO) team supporting Defense Information Systems Agency Pacific (DISA PAC) at Ford Island, Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, HI. Operating under the Global Services Management – Operations II (GSM-O II) Task Order 22 (TN22) Boundary Cyber Defense and Cybersecurity Services Provider (CSSP) contract, the mission is to defend the Department of Defense Information Network (DODIN/DISN), U.S. Pacific Command (USPACOM), and critical mission partner enclaves against sophisticated advanced persistent threats and nation-state cyber actors.  
In this high-impact intelligence and analysis role, you will synthesize multi-source intelligence, telemetry, and forensic data into actionable threat intelligence. You will analyze adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), formulate threat indicators, track advanced adversary campaigns, and direct threat-informed defense operations across perimeter boundaries, multi-cloud platforms, and classified networks—spanning Unclassified (NIPRNet) and Secret (SIPRNet) up to Top Secret/SCI.

**This is a full-time onsite role in Ford Island, HI. Telework is not permitted.**

Yes, 10% of the time.

* **Automated Telemetry & Breach Assessment:** Evaluate bypasses and telemetry from automated blocking platforms to uncover adversary evasion techniques, evaluate malicious patterns, and generate targeted analytic hypotheses.

* **Deliberate Defense (DD) & Discovery Counter Infiltration (DCI):** Formulate threat hypotheses based on all-source intelligence, reconstruct multi-stage adversary attack paths, and conduct structured threat-hunting across enterprise endpoints and cloud enclaves to validate malicious presence or confirm its absence.
* **Multi-Cloud & Zero Trust Threat Analysis:** Track advanced persistent threats operating against enterprise cloud ecosystems (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, Google Cloud Platform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) secured under the Joint Warfighter Cloud Capability, Thunderdome Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and Microsoft Defender suite (EndGuard).
* **Analytic Capability & Use Case Development:** Translate threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into specific detection use cases, rule logic, and detection requirements for ingestion into enterprise SIEMs (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, and JCRS-D).
* **Aggregated Threat Trend Reporting:** Aggregate threat indicators, malware behaviors, and adversary profiles from commercial threat feeds (e.g., CrowdStrike, VirusTotal) and internal investigations; provide inputs for the quarterly Aggregated Cyber Awareness Report detailing strategic threat forecasts and vulnerability exposures.

* **PACOM Mission Network (PMN) and Joint Operational Edge – Coalition Environment (JOE-CE) Threat Assessment:** Provide dedicated cyber threat intelligence and behavioral profiling tailored to the PMN and JOE-CE operational networks.
* **User & Entity Behavioral Profiling:** Analyze Identity, Credential, and Access Management telemetry and the PMN Master User Record to identify anomalous user behavior, insider threats, and sophisticated lateral movement.

All-Source/CI analysts recommend cost-effective protective measures and countermeasures for DARPA personnel, programs, and activities. jobs.description:
***Why Join Rincon Research Corporation (RRC)?***

At Rincon Research Corporation, our primary business is innovating, developing, and fielding digital signal processing (DSP) products and services for the United States Defense and Intelligence Communities in support of national security.

RRC seeks a Program Manager (PM) for signal processing software and hardware development efforts working in a multi-disciplinary Research and Development (R&D) atmosphere with skilled engineers and computer scientists in a highly rewarding personal and professional environment. The PM functions with a high degree of independence exercising responsibility for program cost, schedule, performance, budget, risk, and communications management delivering customer satisfaction while maintaining our company’s outstanding reputation.

Come join the team that is creating cutting edge signal processing and geolocation systems for the future!

***What are the primary responsibilities in the Program Manager position?***

The PM is responsible for all phases of the contract lifecycle including proposal development, staffing, development of plans and schedules, sub-project management and control, conducting formal tests, financial management and forecasting, project reviews, quality, customer relationships, reporting to customers and RRC management, and long-term product support. The PM may also be responsible for one or more projects that may, or may not be interrelated; and may, or may not serve the same customer. The PM may also be responsible for managing teams that are geographically dispersed.

The PM will develop and lead personnel in creative problem solving, implementation of advanced hardware/software capabilities, and real-world testing leading to deployment of prototypes and deliverable systems. RRC's dynamic environment and diverse projects demand flexibility to quickly master new technologies, leverage existing customers to increase business, and develop new customers to enable growth of Rincon.

The PM will also assist senior management and technical staff in setting strategic technology goals to continue our current success in developing leading technologies to solve mission critical problems. A significant aspect of the PM’s responsibilities will be participation in business development activities that include leading and/or authoring contract proposals.

***What*** ***required*** ***background will make you successful?***

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Physics, or other related field
* At least 10 years' experience as an engineer and/or technical program manager
* At least 3 years’ experience as a technical program manager
* Experience creating execution plans and schedules, including financial baselines and forecasts
* Experience building and leading technical teams
* Significant experience writing successful proposals
* Proven track record of successful customer relationship development and management
* Demonstrated history of excellence in program execution
* Active TS/SCI security clearance
* US CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED

***Preferred background:***

* Master's or PhD Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Physics, or other related field
* Professional certification in program management
* Demonstrated ability to write or analyze requirements and test documentation
* Experience developing complex DSP systems as a software developer, hardware developer, or algorithm engineer
* Familiarity with Program Management software tools (ForProject, Microsoft Project, etc.)

***Where is the position located?***

This position can be located at our Centennial, CO; Colorado Springs, CO; or Chantilly, VA locations.

* ***The likely salary range for this position is $165,000 to $200,000. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.***

***What benefits does RRC offer?***

  

* 100% employer-paid premiums for family medical and dental insurance, employee life insurance, short-term and long-term disability (STD & LTD)
* Flexible reimbursement spending accounts for medical expense and dependent care
* Immediate participation and vesting in the company’s Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and 401(k) Plan
* Employer contributions to RRC’s ESOP
* Employer matching contributions to the company’s 401( k) Plan
* Employer discretionary contributions to the company’s 401(k) Plan

Rincon Research Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

jobs.description:
**Junior Business Analyst Overview**
------------------------------------

HumanTouch is seeking a Junior Business Analyst to support discovery and requirements development for Government customers. You will help investigate operational challenges, analyze business processes, and turn stakeholder input into clear findings and requirements while developing your skills with guidance from a senior analyst.

**General Description**
-----------------------

The Junior Business Analyst works with a senior analyst, the Project Manager, and the project team to understand current operations and document business needs. This role requires curiosity, careful listening, and the ability to organize incomplete information, ask useful follow-up questions, and contribute substantive analysis and accurate documentation.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Help develop interview questions and workshop materials, and adapt discovery templates with guidance from the senior analyst.
* Participate in stakeholder discussions, asking follow-up questions to clarify processes, investigate inconsistencies, and uncover missing information. Organize findings, constraints, workarounds, and questions requiring follow-up.
* Develop and update process maps showing activities, decision points, handoffs, responsibilities, and dependencies.
* Research relevant policies, procedures, existing documentation, and other available sources. Analyze findings to identify themes, gaps, and potential causes of operational problems.
* Draft findings, improvement opportunities, and business and system requirements for senior review, distinguishing supporting evidence from assumptions and open questions.
* Check requirements for clarity, consistency, completeness, and alignment with source findings. Support stakeholder reviews to confirm that process maps and requirements reflect the business need, incorporating feedback and tracking open questions.
* Use approved AI tools to improve the efficiency of assigned research, analysis, and documentation. Check AI-assisted outputs against source materials, correct inaccuracies, and raise uncertain findings for senior review while following applicable data-handling requirements.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------

Experience supporting Government customers or working with policy-driven operational processes. Familiarity with stakeholder interviews, requirements gathering, process-improvement activities, and process-mapping or collaborative documentation tools.

**Work Experience Requirements**
--------------------------------

* Two or more years of relevant experience in business analysis, process improvement, or operational work involving analysis and documentation.
* Experience organizing information from discussions, documents, or other sources into clear written findings.
* Ability to document workflows and recognize unclear steps, missing information, or conflicting accounts.
* Research and problem-solving skills, including distinguishing documented facts from assumptions and drawing conclusions supported by evidence.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with customers and team members.
* Ability to complete assigned work, incorporate feedback, and raise questions when clarification or guidance is needed.
* Practical experience using AI tools to support analysis and documentation, with the ability to evaluate outputs, recognize unsupported claims, and perform the underlying analysis with senior guidance.

**Education Requirements**
--------------------------

A bachelor's degree in business, information systems, public administration, or a related field is preferred, not required. Candidates without a degree are encouraged to apply if their professional experience demonstrates the required analytical, research, and communication skills and they meet the work experience requirements.

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Vision and Dental Coverage
* 401(k) Matching
* PTO

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Senior
jobs.description:
**Senior Business Analyst Overview**
------------------------------------

HumanTouch is seeking a Senior Business Analyst to help Government customers understand operational challenges and turn complex or loosely defined problems into clear requirements. You will lead discovery, investigate how work happens in practice, and develop findings that help customers make informed decisions about process and system improvements.

**General Description**
-----------------------

The Senior Business Analyst independently translates the scope, objectives, and constraints in a statement of work into a practical discovery and requirements-gathering plan. Working with the Project Manager and project team, this role designs and leads interviews and workshops, maps business processes, analyzes findings, and develops validated requirements. The analyst also provides direction and feedback to junior analysts.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Interpret the statement of work and available background information to define discovery objectives, identify information gaps, and develop a sequenced plan aligned with the engagement scope and deliverables.
* Independently select and design the requirements-gathering approach based on the problem, stakeholder groups, and operational context, identifying assumptions or scope questions that require customer clarification.
* Design workshop structures, including objectives, participants, agendas, facilitation activities, and expected outputs, to investigate processes and reconcile differing perspectives. Develop tailored interview guides and reusable discovery templates.
* Lead interviews and facilitate workshops, asking focused questions to uncover unstated needs, exceptions, workarounds, and differences between documented procedures and actual practice. Adapt the approach as findings emerge.
* Map and analyze business processes across teams, documenting decision points, handoffs, responsibilities, dependencies, and bottlenecks.
* Research relevant policies, procedures, existing documentation, and available operational evidence. Analyze findings across sources to identify themes, conflicting accounts, underlying causes, and improvement opportunities.
* Translate validated findings into clear, specific, and verifiable business and system requirements, distinguishing underlying needs from proposed solutions and maintaining the connection to supporting evidence.
* Verify requirements for clarity, consistency, completeness, and evidentiary support. Validate process documentation and requirements with stakeholders to confirm they reflect actual operations, business needs, and intended outcomes.
* Present evidence-based findings and recommendations, identifying assumptions and unresolved questions. Review and guide junior analysts' work.
* Use approved AI tools to improve the efficiency of research, analysis, and documentation. Independently verify AI-assisted outputs against source evidence, correct errors and unsupported conclusions, and follow applicable customer and company data-handling requirements.
* Additional responsibilities include supporting growth and proposal efforts, as well as expanding business within you assigned portfolio

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------

Experience supporting Government customers or working in environments where policies and organizational responsibilities shape operations. Experience analyzing processes that involve multiple teams or organizations, and familiarity with process-mapping and requirements-management tools.

**Work Experience Requirements**
--------------------------------

* Five or more years of relevant experience in business analysis, requirements development, or business process improvement.
* Demonstrated experience independently planning and leading discovery from a statement of work or similarly defined engagement scope, including designing workshops and selecting requirements-gathering methods without step-by-step direction.
* Proven ability to analyze ambiguous or conflicting information, develop process maps, and translate operational findings into actionable requirements.
* Strong research and analytical skills, including evaluating sources, testing assumptions, and identifying missing evidence.
* Clear written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain findings to business and technical audiences.
* Sound judgment in working with customers, completing assigned analysis activities, and raising issues that require a decision.
* Practical experience using AI tools in analysis and documentation, with the ability to evaluate outputs, verify supporting evidence, and perform the underlying business analysis independently of AI.

**Education Requirements**
--------------------------

A bachelor's degree in business, information systems, public administration, or a related field is preferred, not required. Candidates without a degree are encouraged to apply if their professional experience demonstrates the required analytical, research, and communication skills and they meet the work experience requirements.

**Benefits**:

* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
* 401(k) Matching
* PTO

jobs.title: Regulatory Readiness Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Regulatory Readiness Obligation Management team works across regulatory domains (e.g. Privacy, Integrity, Security) and partners closely with Legal, Policy, Operations, and Product to understand and respond to key external pressures that could impact Meta's businesses. We work with our partners to develop and scale Meta’s end-to-end Regulatory Readiness program. The Regulatory Readiness Program Manager supporting a given regulatory area is central to ensuring Product can identify how external pressures may impact current and/or future product plans.This role is suitable for those seeking to work closely with product teams on a daily basis, and for those seeking to understand how regulatory, competitive, and legal matters relate to Meta's data practices and product offerings. As this is a highly visible role that requires leadership, good stakeholder management, technical know-how, and well-structured operations, the successful candidate should navigate ambiguity by defining structure, clarifying priorities, and driving alignment across cross-functional teams and have a desire to solve complex, cross-functional regulatory and product challenges.This role will work with leadership including executives at the company, on some of the biggest priorities for the company.  
  
  

### **Regulatory Readiness Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Ensure Product is aware of external pressures identified by Legal, Policy, and teams working on forecasting and analysis of the competitive landscape
* Lead gap analyses that allow Product teams to more easily identify deltas between new regulations and existing product and/or strategic positions
* Identify opportunities for alignment across domains. Especially opportunities for alignment between Regulatory Readiness Strategic Program Managers
* Work with teams across domains to identify conflicting requirements and initiatives and improve collaboration across groups responsible for long-term regulatory strategy
* Scale the capacity of the Regulatory Readiness team through process optimization, right-sizing, and up-skilling
* Drive progress on priority work-streams and help build decision-making frameworks and deliverables
* Prepare communication materials and progress tracking for multiple audiences, including leadership

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in strategy, management consulting, business operations, program management, regulatory operations, or other operational discipline
* 3+ years of experience working within a product environment and partnering with cross-functional stakeholders, including legal, policy and product functions
* 2+ years of experience working in a regulatory domain like privacy, integrity, security OR in a role associated with data protection, regulatory response, operational risk management, compliance, audit and implementation of control frameworks, privacy by design, information security, or other highly regulated environment
* Proven project management, problem solving, time-management and organizational skills, and the experience to set strategic priorities combined with a demonstrated history of delivering operational results
* Experience facilitating alignment and driving decisions across stakeholders with differing priorities or requirements

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Project Management / Program Management Certification(s)
* Demonstrated knowledge of a domain’s requirements (e.g. Privacy, Integrity, Security), preferable those applicable to a global tech company, and experience evaluating products or processes to ensure compliance with applicable requirements

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

The Cloud & AI organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their full potential each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. Microsoft is one of the largest enterprise service companies in the world.

If you have a deep background in analysis and want to be at the forefront of threat tracking and technique discovery, the Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center (MSTIC) wants to hear from you. As a Principal Threat Intelligence Analyst on our team, you will obtain real-time visibility into hundreds of simultaneous intrusions and convert this into finished intelligence, prioritized judgments, and protection at scale. The successful candidate is a critical thinker and problem solver, skilled at discovering novel intrusions and adversary tradecraft through analysis, and curious enough to pursue impact through product hardening and disruptions where there is no precedent.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

Discovering and analyzing attacker activity across on-premises and cloud environments.

Identifying potential threats, allowing for proactive defense and customer notification before an actual incident.

Providing recommendations to improve customers’ cybersecurity posture going forward and performing threat intelligence knowledge transfer to prepare customers to defend against today’s threat landscape.

Building proof-of-concept and prototype threat hunting tools, automations, and new capabilities.

Driving product and tooling improvements by conveying learnings from threat intelligence and intrusion analysis at scale to engineering partner teams.

Using large-scale query workflows to distill adversary signal within an unparalleled volume of potentially malicious activity to pivot, validate, and scope what matters.

 **Qualifications**

Required/minimum qualifications

Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field

OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND proven experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection

OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND substantial experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

Proven knowledge of security fundamentals across Microsoft platforms (Client, Server, Cloud), especially identity, cloud control planes, and enterprise attack paths.  
Understanding of malware, tooling, and related activity well enough to extract indicators and develop detections for attacker methods. Reverse engineering or detection engineering depth is a plus, not a requirement. Curiosity and ingenuity matter as much as years of technical experience.  
Experience producing strategic, operational, and tactical threat intelligence, including actor tracking, campaign clustering, and analytic writing for technical and executive audiences.  
Familiarity and understanding of SQL or Kusto Query Language (KQL) queries (or experience with large database/SIEM query languages such as Splunk/Humio/Kibana, etc.)  
Deep knowledge of endpoint, email, and cloud forensic log artifacts - or similar experience in analysis of SIEM logs, web server logs, AV logs, and security logs.  
Experience building and reviewing threat hunting automations using scripting languages.  
Experience developing collection requirements, judging source reliability, and turning raw telemetry and partner reporting into actionable assessments.  
Demonstrated advanced problem solving, troubleshooting, and analysis skills.

==================================================================

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

We are looking for a data-driven Business Analyst who will play a pivotal role in support of our Europe Go-To-Market team, focused on the Legal product portfolio. You will drive forward critical projects, monitor and support improvements in operational performance and create actionable, impactful insights from complex data.

  

This role requires someone with 3-5 years of experience which covers project management, data analysis and stakeholder management. Experience in B2B Software and exposure to Legal workflows is an advantage but not required.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Project Management**

Drive operational projects for Sales and Retention leads, acting as PM to execute on key strategic initiatives. You will own initiatives from conception to execution, managing timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment to rapidly drive outcomes.

### **Data Translation & Insights**

Pull data from across the company (Finance, Rev Ops, Sales and Retention) and externally (market sizing and competitor insights) to turn into high-impact, actionable insights for Sales and enablement teams. Create comprehensive reports, dashboards, and analyses that drive decisions on territory strategies, pipeline targets, and resource allocation. Monitor operational performance for your product portfolio; escalate issues and flag risks and opportunities. Track key performance indicators, identify performance gaps, and recommend corrective actions.

**Who we are looking for**

  

We are looking for a Data and AI Program Manager reporting directly to global Data and AI Chief of Staff. You will serve as an enterprise leader for Data and AI, overseeing the planning, execution, and delivery of enterprise wide Data and AI initiatives.

  

**Why this role is important to us**

  

The team you will be joining is a part of Data and AI organization, a function that is vital to the company. The Data and AI Program Manager will ensure the disciplined execution and value realization while delivering clear, compelling communication to internal and external stakeholders. The role operates at the intersection of strategy, program management, and executive communication.

  

**What you will be responsible for**

  

As a Data and AI Program Manager, you will:
  

* **Coordinate and lead global Data and AI Programs** by partnering with cross‑regional technology teams, business stakeholders, and vendors on the **planning, execution, and implementation of IT initiatives** . Own **day‑to‑day management** of assigned programs to ensure delivery against agreed scope, schedule, budget, and quality.

* **Own program documentation and governance** , including program plans, status reports, and key decision records. Ensure full alignment with **program and project governance, risk management, and audit requirements** , and provide proactive support during internal or external reviews.

* **Identify, track, and manage program and operational risks** , maintaining up‑to‑date mitigation and contingency plans. Proactively resolve issues where possible and **escalate critical risks and dependencies** in a timely and structured manner to ensure informed decision‑making by leadership.

* **Act as a key stakeholder interface** , ensuring alignment across technology, business, and management teams, and delivering clear, accurate, and audience‑appropriate program communications.

  

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role

* **Experience in Enterprise wide program management with demonstrated project management capability in technology‑enabled environments.**

* **Excellent communication skills,** **with the ability to collaborate effectively with global, cross‑functional stakeholders in both verbal and written contexts.**

* **High proficiency in project and productivity tools** , including Microsoft Office, MS Project, Jira, Clarity, Confluence, and similar platforms. Experience with analytics tools such as **Power BI is** a plus.

* **Experience in IT Compliance, Data Management, or AI project management is a plus.**

* **Ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure, demonstrating resilience, adaptability, and sound judgment in fast‑paced and high‑pressure situations.**

  

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

* Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in program management, vendor management, capacity planning, or PMO related roles. Experience working on large-scale programs is preferred.

* Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile and Waterfall methodologies.

* Demonstrated technical understanding of software engineering concepts (e.g., system architecture, APIs/integrations, data flows, cloud basics).

* PMP certification, Data Governance, or any additional project management–related certifications are highly desirable.

  
  

**About State Street**
======================

  

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

  
  

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

  
  

Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers
