new_jobs.title: Regulatory Readiness Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Regulatory Readiness Obligation Management team works across regulatory domains (e.g. Privacy, Integrity, Security) and partners closely with Legal, Policy, Operations, and Product to understand and respond to key external pressures that could impact Meta's businesses. We work with our partners to develop and scale Meta’s end-to-end Regulatory Readiness program. The Regulatory Readiness Program Manager supporting a given regulatory area is central to ensuring Product can identify how external pressures may impact current and/or future product plans.This role is suitable for those seeking to work closely with product teams on a daily basis, and for those seeking to understand how regulatory, competitive, and legal matters relate to Meta's data practices and product offerings. As this is a highly visible role that requires leadership, good stakeholder management, technical know-how, and well-structured operations, the successful candidate should navigate ambiguity by defining structure, clarifying priorities, and driving alignment across cross-functional teams and have a desire to solve complex, cross-functional regulatory and product challenges.This role will work with leadership including executives at the company, on some of the biggest priorities for the company.  
  
  

### **Regulatory Readiness Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Ensure Product is aware of external pressures identified by Legal, Policy, and teams working on forecasting and analysis of the competitive landscape
* Lead gap analyses that allow Product teams to more easily identify deltas between new regulations and existing product and/or strategic positions
* Identify opportunities for alignment across domains. Especially opportunities for alignment between Regulatory Readiness Strategic Program Managers
* Work with teams across domains to identify conflicting requirements and initiatives and improve collaboration across groups responsible for long-term regulatory strategy
* Scale the capacity of the Regulatory Readiness team through process optimization, right-sizing, and up-skilling
* Drive progress on priority work-streams and help build decision-making frameworks and deliverables
* Prepare communication materials and progress tracking for multiple audiences, including leadership

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in strategy, management consulting, business operations, program management, regulatory operations, or other operational discipline
* 3+ years of experience working within a product environment and partnering with cross-functional stakeholders, including legal, policy and product functions
* 2+ years of experience working in a regulatory domain like privacy, integrity, security OR in a role associated with data protection, regulatory response, operational risk management, compliance, audit and implementation of control frameworks, privacy by design, information security, or other highly regulated environment
* Proven project management, problem solving, time-management and organizational skills, and the experience to set strategic priorities combined with a demonstrated history of delivering operational results
* Experience facilitating alignment and driving decisions across stakeholders with differing priorities or requirements

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Project Management / Program Management Certification(s)
* Demonstrated knowledge of a domain’s requirements (e.g. Privacy, Integrity, Security), preferable those applicable to a global tech company, and experience evaluating products or processes to ensure compliance with applicable requirements

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

new_jobs.description:
**Overview**

The Cloud & AI organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their full potential each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world. Microsoft is one of the largest enterprise service companies in the world.

If you have a deep background in analysis and want to be at the forefront of threat tracking and technique discovery, the Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center (MSTIC) wants to hear from you. As a Principal Threat Intelligence Analyst on our team, you will obtain real-time visibility into hundreds of simultaneous intrusions and convert this into finished intelligence, prioritized judgments, and protection at scale. The successful candidate is a critical thinker and problem solver, skilled at discovering novel intrusions and adversary tradecraft through analysis, and curious enough to pursue impact through product hardening and disruptions where there is no precedent.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

Discovering and analyzing attacker activity across on-premises and cloud environments.

Identifying potential threats, allowing for proactive defense and customer notification before an actual incident.

Providing recommendations to improve customers’ cybersecurity posture going forward and performing threat intelligence knowledge transfer to prepare customers to defend against today’s threat landscape.

Building proof-of-concept and prototype threat hunting tools, automations, and new capabilities.

Driving product and tooling improvements by conveying learnings from threat intelligence and intrusion analysis at scale to engineering partner teams.

Using large-scale query workflows to distill adversary signal within an unparalleled volume of potentially malicious activity to pivot, validate, and scope what matters.

 **Qualifications**

Required/minimum qualifications

Doctorate in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field

OR Master's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND proven experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection

OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Security, or related field AND substantial experience in software development lifecycle, large-scale computing, threat analysis or modeling, cybersecurity, vulnerability research, and/or anomaly detection OR equivalent experience.

Additional or preferred qualifications

Proven knowledge of security fundamentals across Microsoft platforms (Client, Server, Cloud), especially identity, cloud control planes, and enterprise attack paths.  
Understanding of malware, tooling, and related activity well enough to extract indicators and develop detections for attacker methods. Reverse engineering or detection engineering depth is a plus, not a requirement. Curiosity and ingenuity matter as much as years of technical experience.  
Experience producing strategic, operational, and tactical threat intelligence, including actor tracking, campaign clustering, and analytic writing for technical and executive audiences.  
Familiarity and understanding of SQL or Kusto Query Language (KQL) queries (or experience with large database/SIEM query languages such as Splunk/Humio/Kibana, etc.)  
Deep knowledge of endpoint, email, and cloud forensic log artifacts - or similar experience in analysis of SIEM logs, web server logs, AV logs, and security logs.  
Experience building and reviewing threat hunting automations using scripting languages.  
Experience developing collection requirements, judging source reliability, and turning raw telemetry and partner reporting into actionable assessments.  
Demonstrated advanced problem solving, troubleshooting, and analysis skills.

**Job Description**
-------------------

  

We are looking for a data-driven Business Analyst who will play a pivotal role in support of our Europe Go-To-Market team, focused on the Legal product portfolio. You will drive forward critical projects, monitor and support improvements in operational performance and create actionable, impactful insights from complex data.

Drive operational projects for Sales and Retention leads, acting as PM to execute on key strategic initiatives. You will own initiatives from conception to execution, managing timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment to rapidly drive outcomes.

Pull data from across the company (Finance, Rev Ops, Sales and Retention) and externally (market sizing and competitor insights) to turn into high-impact, actionable insights for Sales and enablement teams. new_jobs.title: AT Beacon Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
This is a pivotal role for AT Beacon Project. As Project Manager, you will hold overall programme management responsibility for a growing community health programme reaching some of Lambeth's most underserved residents, coordinating delivery across five neighbourhood outreach sites, a small multidisciplinary team, and a full core offer spanning health assessment, primary care navigation, behaviour change support and targeted practical support. Given the scale and complexity of the programme, and the level of accountability it carries, this role calls for a seasoned programme manager who can bring genuine rigour to budget oversight, risk management and reporting, ideally someone with a track record in a comparable role.

The role is delivery-focused and externally facing, with significant responsibility for day-to-day operations, contract and budget performance, and partner relationships. You will liaise with commissioners and system partners, monitor contract and budget performance against agreed targets, and cultivate strong working relationships with stakeholders, Integrated Neighbourhood Team leads, community leaders, local businesses, and faith-based organisations to establish meaningful partnerships and support the effective delivery of operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Delivery**

* Coordinate the effective running of outreach sites and pop-ups across the core offer, including health assessments, health navigation/signposting, targeted practical support enrolment, behaviour change workshops, and Ambassador-led community engagement, ensuring they meet project goals.
* Coordinate staff rotas across outreach sites to ensure adequate coverage.
* Oversee delivery of regular wellbeing drop-in sessions and targeted outreach in high-footfall and trusted community settings.

**Programme, Contract & Budget Management**

* Coordinate collection, quality assurance and timely submission of KPI data and reports to
* commissioners, in line with contractual requirements, ensuring accuracy and consistency across all outreach sites.
* Maintain a benefits and outcomes register, tracking delivery against the programme's value-for-money case, and using this evidence to inform ongoing KPI monitoring and commissioner reporting.
* Support programme leads in monitoring the programme budget and preparing budget papers and financial justification for commissioners.
* Maintain a programme risk and issue log, escalating appropriately to programme leads and the AT Beacon Management Group.
* Represent AT Beacon at scheduled monitoring and performance meetings, providing clear evidence of KPI performance, outcomes and impact.
* Prepare quarterly and end-of-project summary reports on programme delivery, KPI performance and outcomes.

**Line Management**

* Supervise and support delivery staff, providing guidance, induction, training, and coordination to meet targets and maintain project documentation.
* Recruit, train, and coordinate the volunteer network supporting outreach delivery.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Ensure outreach activity complies with AT Beacon's policies.
* Ensure compliance with the Ascension Trust Data Protection Policy and AT Beacon Data Processing Strategy, including secure handling of any client data and adherence to UK GDPR.

**Community & System Relationships**

* Build and maintain relationships with PCN Leads, Integrated Neighbourhood Team leads, commissioners, faith and community partners to support aligned referral and signposting pathways.
* Explore new opportunities for outreach and partnership on the ground, in line with the programme's aims.
* Present regular reports on project progress, outcomes and budget position to the AT Beacon Project Management Group.
* Any other relevant duties pertaining to the work of the AT Beacon Project.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Programme/Project Management Experience: Minimum 3 years managing a complex, multi-stakeholder programme or project. Direct experience working within the NHS, an Integrated Care System or Primary Care Network landscape is strongly preferred; equivalent experience in public health, local authority or third sector commissioned services will also be considered. A demonstrable track record of successful delivery against agreed outcomes and deadlines is essential.
* Budget & Financial Management: Experience monitoring programme budgets, tracking expenditure against plan, and producing clear, evidence-based financial and value-for-money justification for funders or commissioners, including tracking outcomes against a programme's original benefits or return-on-investment case.
* Risk & Governance: Experience maintaining risk/issue logs and reporting into a formal governance structure (e.g. management board, steering group, commissioner review).
* Organisational Skills: Strong ability to multitask, manage time effectively, and ensure project milestones are met.
* Team Leadership and Collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively within a team, as well as to lead and inspire others in delivering on project objectives.
* Strong communication skills: Able to effectively engage diverse groups, including vulnerable populations, community leaders, and healthcare providers, both orally and in writing.
* Experience of contract and KPI reporting: Comfortable working to structured reporting cycles and translating operational activity into commissioner-facing performance data.
* Capable of managing and prioritising one's workflow while working on multiple projects at once.
* Capable of working successfully under pressure and within tight timelines.
* Cultural Competence and Empathy: Sensitivity to the needs and lived experiences of vulnerable and ethnically diverse communities, for example Black, Portuguese-speaking and Spanish-speaking communities.
* Experience of recruiting, training, and coordinating a volunteer network in community outreach.

* Recognised project/programme management

new_jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and analytical Junior Business Analyst to join our restaurant business. This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who is interested in data analysis, business performance, and improving restaurant operations.

Working closely with restaurant managers, finance, operations, and senior management, you will help analyse sales performance, food costs, labour costs, customer feedback, and operational efficiency across the business.

You will support the team in turning business data into meaningful insights, identifying opportunities for improvement, and helping the business make informed decisions. Guidance and support will be provided to help you develop your analytical and commercial skills.

Key Responsibilities

* Collect, organise, and analyse restaurant data, including sales, food and beverage revenue, labour costs, and operating expenses.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports to monitor restaurant performance.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs), including sales growth, average transaction value, food cost percentage, labour cost percentage, and customer satisfaction.
* Assist in analysing menu performance, identifying popular dishes, and highlighting opportunities to improve profitability.
* Monitor food waste, stock usage, purchasing trends, and inventory performance.
* Compare actual business performance against budgets, forecasts, and previous periods.
* Support restaurant managers in identifying operational challenges and opportunities to improve efficiency.
* Analyse customer feedback, reviews, and satisfaction data to identify areas for service improvement.
* Maintain accurate spreadsheets, databases, and reporting records.
* Prepare reports and presentations for management meetings.
* Support business improvement projects, system implementations, and reporting process improvements.
* Work with restaurant operations, finance, and procurement teams to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

Essential Skills and Requirements

* A degree, diploma, or equivalent qualification in Business Management, Business Analysis, Finance, Accounting, Hospitality Management, Data Analytics, or a related field is desirable.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, sorting, filtering, and pivot tables, or a willingness to develop these skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when handling data.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to interpret information and present findings clearly.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
* A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to work collaboratively.
* An interest in restaurant operations, food and beverage, and commercial business performance.

Desirable Experience

* Previous experience in a restaurant, café, quick-service restaurant, or food and beverage environment is an advantage but not essential.
* Familiarity with point-of-sale (POS) systems, stock management software, or restaurant reporting systems.
* Basic knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualisation tools.
* Understanding of restaurant sales, food costs, labour scheduling, stock control, and profitability.
* Exposure to budgeting, forecasting, or business performance reporting.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Junior Business Analyst will help monitor and report on:

* Sales performance: Daily sales, weekly revenue, and sales growth.
* Food cost percentage: Ingredient costs relative to food sales.
* Labour cost percentage: Staff costs relative to revenue.
* Menu profitability: Sales volumes and contribution margins of individual menu items.
* Stock and waste: Inventory usage, stock variances, and food waste levels.
* Customer satisfaction: Customer feedback, ratings, complaints, and service quality.
* Operational performance: Sales by location, trading period, and service channel.
* Budget performance: Actual revenue and costs compared with budgets and forecasts.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary of £31,000–£33,000 per annum.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Data Analyst to help us turn data into useful insights and make better business decisions while contributing to the continued development of our data infrastructure. In this role, you’ll independently partner with stakeholders across the organization to explore data, improve reporting, answer business questions, define meaningful metrics, and develop practical, reusable solutions. You’ll also help test, validate, and execute new data models, processes, and tools as we build a more scalable data foundation. * Test and execute new data models, reporting processes, and analytical workflows; identify issues, document findings, and provide feedback to improve scalability and usability.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 4+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, operations analysis, finance, product analytics, or a related field.

* Strong problem-solving, communication, organization, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to exercise sound judgment when working with complex or imperfect data.

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Experience with a BI or visualization tool such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or a similar platform.
* Experience validating data models, reporting pipelines, data transformations, or analytical workflows across multiple systems.
* Familiarity with data modeling concepts such as tables, dimensions, measures, data grain, reusable reporting datasets, and metric definitions.
* Exposure to Python, R, APIs, data warehouses, ETL/ELT, dbt, lakehouse concepts, Git, or other data development practices.
* Experience improving data quality, automating manual reporting, documenting data processes, or helping establish analytics standards.

**COMPENSATION**

* **Base Salary:** $80,000 - $150,000

* **Equity + Benefits** including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

*Your actual level and base salary will be* *determined* *on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.*

**Annual Salary Range:** PM1 $74,880 - $91,520, PM2 $93,600 - $135,200

**Direct Supervisor:** Program Director

**Direct Reports:** Residential Services Manager, Clinical Manager

**Job Summary**

The Program Manager oversees the daily staff, administrative workflows, operational resources, and regulatory compliance supporting ARS substance use disorder (SUD) treatment programs, clinical teams, and facility-based services. Working under the direction of the Chief Operations Officer, the Program Manager identifies operational needs, resolves program friction points, and coordinates facility operations to maintain program capacity, quality client care, and organizational standards.

Success in this role requires sound administrative judgment, discretion, effective cross-departmental communication, and the ability to equip direct reports and program staff to execute standard operating procedures. The Program Manager ensures program compliance with California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) licensing standards, organizational policies, contractual requirements, and Incidental Medical Services (IMS) regulations where applicable.

**Essential Functions**

* General Program Operations & Supervisory Oversight

* Staff Leadership & Supervision: Supervise assigned direct reports (including the Residential Services Manager and program administrative staff), establishing clear performance expectations, conducting coaching, evaluating job performance, and managing progressive discipline.
* Capacity & Occupancy Management: Monitor program capacity and coordinate admissions and census tracking to maintain appropriate facility occupancy while supporting quality client care.
* Client Care & Intake Coordination: Oversee client intakes, room/bed assignments, transfers, and step-down or discharge planning in consultation with the Clinical Team and program supervisors.
* Recordkeeping & Chart Quality: Oversee the completeness, accuracy, and timely maintenance of client charts, personnel records, electronic health record (EHR) entries, and required state reporting systems within assigned areas of responsibility.
* Facility & Resource Coordination: Monitor program facilities, supplies, nutrition, and physical plant conditions, coordinating maintenance and supply needs with responsible departments to maintain safe, clean, and compliant environments.
* Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Facilitate structured coordination between program operations, clinical services, medical/nursing staff, administrative departments, and executive leadership.
* Incidental Medical Services (IMS) & Clinical Operations Management

* IMS Program Governance: Oversee facility operational systems to ensure full alignment with DHCS licensing regulations and ARS Incidental Medical Services (IMS) policies across all applicable categories (medical history screening, health status monitoring, testing, treatment support, medication oversight, and withdrawal management support).
* Medical & Health Services Oversight: Ensure established operational protocols are in place for client health screenings, routine health status monitoring, vital signs tracking, and emergency medical escalation, coordinating closely with licensed Health Care Practitioners (HCPs) and Clinical Leadership.
* Medication Systems & Physical Plant Compliance: Oversee program medication storage protocols—including double-lock medication security, locked narcotic storage, MAR audit controls, and IMS room physical plant standards—ensuring staff adhere to nonmedical medication oversight policies.
* Care Coordination & MAT Support: Ensure program pathways support client access to Medications for Addiction Treatment (MAT), Narcotic Treatment Programs (NTPs), and external healthcare providers, eliminating administrative barriers to client care.
* Regulatory Compliance, Quality Assurance & Risk Management

* Licensing & Staffing File Compliance: Maintain required facility licensing files, ensuring current DHCS staffing disclosures, Health Care Practitioner acknowledgements , professional licenses, and staff training documentation are complete and up to date.
* Quality Control & Auditing: Conduct routine quality assurance reviews of client records, medication logs, and facility documentation; participate in periodic operational audits and physical plant inspections to identify and resolve compliance gaps.
* Incident Reporting & State Notifications: Ensure timely completion and escalation of internal incident reports, mandatory state notifications (DHCS filings), and regulatory communications regarding critical events, medical transfers, or policy updates.

Requirements:

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Human Services, Social Work, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of five (5) years of administrative or supervisory experience in alcohol and drug treatment programs, with demonstrated knowledge of program operations.
* Thorough knowledge of DHCS Title 9 residential licensing regulations, Incidental Medical Services (IMS) standards, MAT requirements, and applicable labor laws.
* Solid understanding of the recovery process, substance use disorder treatment dynamics, level of care considerations, and trauma-informed program management.
* Proven ability to manage, coach, and hold direct reports accountable while fostering a collaborative, supportive workplace culture.
* Proficiency in electronic health record (EHR) systems, Paylocity/HRIS tools, data reporting, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Valid California Driver’s License and clean driving record.
* Successful completion of required background screening (DOJ/FBI).
* Current tuberculosis (TB) clearance and physician health screening.
* Current CPR and First Aid cert

Department Overview
  
  
Welcome to Electric Asset Strategy (EAS). We are responsible for asset strategy, standards, procedures, and end-to-end risk management for 2.3 million structures across the electric distribution system. We deliver risk-informed strategic plans that leverage inspection insights and asset data to guide maintenance and investment decisions.
  
  
The Distribution Asset Risk Management (ARM) team—comprising Asset Failure Analysis (AFA), Asset Insights, and Inspections & Maintenance Strategy (I&M)—focuses on continuously improving how PG&E monitors and maintains its assets to support a resilient, reliable grid and help keep our communities safe.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Program Manager, Expert will lead the development, implementation, and financial stewardship of I&M strategy programs for PG&E’s electric distribution assets. The role will translate regulatory requirements, asset condition insights, risk analysis, budget planning, accounting considerations, and operational constraints into executable multiyear strategies and work plans that improve safety, reliability, compliance, affordability, and risk-spend efficiency.
  
  
This position requires strong accounting, financial analysis, investment planning, and practical AI literacy to develop defensible budgets, forecasts, business cases, and funding recommendations. The successful candidate will play a leading role in Business Plan Deployment (BPD); annual and multiyear investment planning; cost and variance analysis; prioritization of competing capital and expense needs; and reconciliation of program scope, unit costs, work volumes, and financial outcomes. The role will use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate research and synthesis, analyze structured and unstructured information, test assumptions, draft and quality-check work products, and improve the speed and consistency of financial, regulatory, and program management activities. The successful candidate will apply sound judgment, protect confidential information, validate outputs against authoritative sources, and maintain clear human accountability. The role will establish performance measures, monitor program and financial results, challenge assumptions, and present clear recommendations to senior leaders and governance forums.
  
  
The Program Manager, Expert will also provide critical regulatory support and may serve as a General Rate Case (GRC) witness assistant, helping coordinate the development of accurate, consistent, and well-supported testimony, workpapers, exhibits, and discovery responses. The role will lead cross-functional responses to regulatory data requests—often on short notice—by rapidly organizing subject-matter experts, validating operational and financial data, documenting assumptions and source support, identifying risks and inconsistencies, and delivering high-quality responses within firm deadlines. Strong partnerships across Asset Strategy, Inspections, Maintenance, Operations, Engineering, Wildfire Risk, Regulatory, Compliance, Finance, Accounting, Law, Technology, data teams, vendors, and external partners will be essential to meeting program and regulatory commitments.
  
  
Compensation
  
  
PG&E is providing the salary range that the company, in good faith, believes it might pay for this position at the time of posting. This compensation range is specific to the job’s location. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, collective bargaining agreements, and internal equity. Although we estimate that the successful candidate will be placed near the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis based on these factors.
